original_failure_cut_review.proposed_review_decision: Reject before victim consumption; no worker invocation. Independent authentication and no-write negative witness required.
Known authenticated invocation consumes before requested mismatch checks; no worker dispatch and no return to unused.
Stop before spawn; consumption remains unknown/null, controller obligations and global no-reuse quarantine pending.
Known claim stays consumed; lost ACK is not fresh admission/launch permission, quarantine and controller obligations persist.
Consumed grant stays burned; unknown launch spend prevents spawn/retry, keep controller quarantine.
Original slot remains spent even if no spawn is known; no restart launch, preserve original pending obligations.
Treat possible machine/child effects and controller obligations as pending; never conclude no child or safe closure, never relaunch.
Original grant remains consumed, original failure status retained; no new grant, no workspace at stage0, actual later effects still require evidence.
Memory bootstrap success grants neither fresh baseline/target proof nor new authority; original next-stage gates remain required.
Traps readiness is not writer exclusion, baseline capture or durable storage proof; full original guarded-baseline/effect graph still required.

protocol_review_rows.required_design_behavior: Before any own ledger/log/receipt write, service own error/obligation handling and full dependencies/writers are reviewed. Worker stage1 is separate.

Authenticate issuer/principal and original known grant/epoch before consumption; unknown/forged caller cannot burn a victim grant. Requested binding/preflight validation must not move ahead of the original burn boundary.
One linearizable crash-durable unused-to-consumed-active compare-and-set; competitors cannot also win, mismatch or worker preflight failure never returns unused.
Unknown commit or lost ACK stops dispatch and globally prevents reuse; consumption remains null when unknown, not rewritten to true/false by lack of evidence. Reconciliation cannot reopen launch.
Durably spend original one launch slot before exact spawn. Restart or uncertain spend/spawn outcome never retries, renews or allocates another slot.

Producer after original durable consumption/spend supplies the exact canonical original authenticated context through original bounded one-way anonymous memory bootstrap; no worker admission socket/RPC.

Read once within original byte/deadline/EOF limits, reject malformed/forged/lost context, close read-end on every success/failure/signal/timeout before child exec, never inherit writer-end or write a worker ledger/log.
Install worker traps before filesystem lock/log/owned writes, then original continuous exclusion/fresh memory capture before owned backup or target mutation; no early preflight promoted to baseline.

Sanitize all FD/environment/cwd/process/namespace/mount/service capabilities on every child including logs/rollback, retain only independently reviewed objects through interpreter consumption; no host fallback.

Keep original failure status, known/unknown outcomes and controller/possible machine obligations; full child drain and finite original phase rights remain required. No grant per nested call or implicitly authorized recovery.

trust_review_rows.required_proposed_boundary: Independently provisioned issuer/service/principal/key provenance, epoch and original known-grant ownership; self-declared UUID/hash/path/environment is not authority.
Reviewed verifier/trust-root/code and independent original launch slot/instance binding; subject receipt must not define its own expected worker/scope.
Controller storage and every writer must be outside worker-owned tree/capability domain, with own obligation handling before ledger or log writes.
Original single launch owner and every child/FD/code/config consumer need native identity and lifetime observation across crash/restart cuts.
Collector/verifier/expected-vector provenance independent of subject and service self-labels; whole admission/launch storage and machine effect vectors retained.
